target: dpd30: 30+ days past due within 18 months (simulated), the Solar book's default flag

features.name: fico_bureau
features.why: A higher credit score never means higher risk.

features.name: dti_stated
features.why: More debt burden never means lower risk (the simulated hazard is flat below 36%, which the constraint allows).

features.name: stated_monthly_debts
features.why: More stated debt never means lower risk.

features.name: income_stated
features.why: More income never means higher risk at the same obligations.

features.name: income_overstatement_pct
features.why: Stating more income than the employer verifies is misrepresentation.

features.name: undisclosed_debt
features.why: Bureau debt the application leaves out is concealment.

features.name: undisclosed_accounts
features.why: Bureau accounts the application leaves out are concealment.

features.name: checking_overstatement_pct
features.why: Stating more cash than the statement shows is fabrication.

features.name: statement_excess_pct
features.why: A statement showing more cash than stated points to an altered document.

features.name: checking_stated
features.why: More stated reserves never mean higher risk.

features.name: checking_statement
features.why: More verified reserves never mean higher risk.

features.name: overdraft_count
features.why: More overdrafts never mean lower risk.

features.name: tenure_months
features.why: Longer employment never means higher risk.

DEBT_BURDEN.statement: Debt obligations too high relative to income

INCOME_LEVEL.statement: Income insufficient for the amount of credit requested

INCOME_DISCREPANCY.statement: Income could not be verified at the amount stated

UNDISCLOSED_DEBT.statement: Credit report shows obligations not disclosed on the application

ASSET_DISCREPANCY.statement: Stated account balance does not match the bank statement

UNSOURCED_DEPOSITS.statement: Recent large deposits are not sourced

excluded: age, region, zip_code, cost_of_living_index, persona, regime and every audit attribute (sensitive or geographic)
the credit bureau's persona field (a generator type, not a lender field)
dealer_id (dealer risk belongs to the Dealer View)
device and session metadata (fraud signals, not creditworthiness)
fraud-rule outputs (reasons come from the raw fields)
W-2 wages (a partial-year artefact for short tenures)
world truth, the corruption label, dealer quality and PD (answer key only)
